description: Template for a DIFFERENT setup: complete independent tuning/component records before use. For the supplied CSV use deuteron-baseline-setup.json, which already records its known n=1 and 3.580 m half-wave. Nulls prevent silent propagation assumptions.

cable_tuning.source: REPLACE with the cable tuning record; do not infer the integer from the unconstrained baseline fit

reference_hz.source: User-confirmed nominal center for the 500-bin deuteron baseline acquisition; not an independent measurement of exact resonance

drive_v.source: Nominal engineering seed, not an independently confirmed RF voltage

drive_resistance_ohm.source: Nominal source resistor; replace with measured value/tolerance

input_resistance_ohm.source: Nominal input loading; replace with characterized value

damping_resistance_ohm.source: Nominal damping resistor; replace with measured value/tolerance

coil_resistance_ohm.source: Nominal RF coil resistance; replace with characterization

coil_inductance_h.source: Nominal coil inductance; replace with characterization

tune_capacitance_f.source: REPLACE with calibrated capacitor setting and supported bounds

stray_capacitance_f.source: REPLACE with measured value or bounded unknown parasitic capacitance

cable_resistance_ohm_per_m.source: Nominal distributed cable resistance; replace with characterization

cable_inductance_h_per_m.source: REPLACE with characterized L per meter or derive jointly with C from known cable half-wave and nominal/measured impedance and losses; use calibrated_cable_lc for the G=0 case.

cable_conductance_s_per_m.source: Explicit negligible dielectric-leakage approximation, not a measured zero

cable_capacitance_f_per_m.source: REPLACE with characterized C per meter or derive jointly with L; do not reuse cable constants inconsistent with the known half-wave length.

cable_delta_length_m.source: REPLACE with supported trim/connector/reference-plane tolerance about the known half-wave multiple

detector_phase_slope_rad_per_hz.source: Constant-phase approximation; replace if a phase-versus-frequency measurement exists

detector_phase_curvature_rad_per_hz2.source: Constant-phase approximation; replace if a phase-versus-frequency measurement exists

readout_gain.source: REPLACE with known gain or bounds in recorded units per node volt; do not free RF voltage simultaneously

readout_phase_rad.source: REPLACE with the actual detector phase setting or justified range in radians

readout_offset.source: REPLACE with offset measurement or justified unknown range in recorded units
